items.description:
Shoprite Westridge is a supermarket branch anchoring Westridge Shopping Centre on Wespoort Drive in Mitchells Plain. The store combines a full grocery range with its own in-store bakery, meat market and deli counters, giving shoppers fresh bread, meat and prepared foods alongside everyday packaged goods and household essentials.

As part of the Shoprite group, one of South Africa's largest supermarket chains, the Westridge branch follows the group's model of pairing bulk grocery ranges with fresh in-house departments under one roof. It serves residents and shoppers across Mitchells Plain and the surrounding Westridge community, trading from its anchor position within the shopping centre. Shoppers can expect a full weekly grocery run covered in a single stop, from fresh produce and meat to bakery items and household basics.

items.description:
Sonder Cafe is a vintage-style coffee shop on Lower Main Road in Observatory, serving New York-style foods including bagels alongside coffee and art. The cafe opened in January 2021 around a simple idea: that connection matters, even between strangers, and that coffee, music, art and games are a way to build it.

The space leans into its vintage aesthetic, with decor that feels more like a comfortable kitchen nook than a conventional coffee shop and vintage knick-knacks dotted throughout, plus a chessboard set out for anyone who wants a game with their coffee. Sonder also runs a second location in Bo-Kaap, and the Observatory space can be hired out for private functions and events. It suits regulars looking for a relaxed, characterful spot to linger over coffee, bagels and conversation in Observatory.

SPAR Fish Hoek is a supermarket branch in the Valyland Centre on Recreation Road, Fish Hoek, stocking a full range of groceries, fresh produce and household essentials. Shoppers single out the in-store bakery and butchery counters as a reason to keep coming back, alongside the usual range of packaged goods and fresh produce.

As part of the independently run SPAR group, the Fish Hoek branch supplies the surrounding community with everyday grocery needs from a single, well-located store in the centre. It trades Monday to Saturday from 07:00 to 19:00 and Sundays from 08:00 to 19:00, making it a convenient stop for last-minute items as well as the full weekly shop. It suits Fish Hoek residents and visitors who want fresh produce, meat and baked goods close to home.

items.description:
The Vet Store is a pet shop inside Capricorn Square in Muizenberg, stocking pet food and accessories for dogs and cats. The store is vet-owned, and its staff are trained as Veterinary Nutritional Advisors, so shoppers can get guidance on diet and food choices for their pets alongside the products themselves.

Trading from its own unit within Capricorn Square, the store focuses specifically on pet nutrition and everyday pet-care items rather than a broad general range, giving it a clear niche within the centre's retail mix. It serves pet owners, particularly dog and cat owners, who may already be shopping elsewhere in the centre and want a dedicated, knowledgeable pet-food stop in the same trip. Regular shoppers can expect current stock of major pet food brands and accessories, with staff able to advise on specific dietary needs.

ThreeZero is a boutique fitness studio in the Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village in De Waterkant, built around Technogym's Biocircuit training system. The circuit uses AI to guide members through a personalised 30-minute workout that combines cardio and strength training in one session, adjusting to each person's level as they move through the machines.

The studio is a Vitality-accredited fitness centre, and alongside the Biocircuit itself it has change rooms, showers and a social space where members can relax before or after a session. This format suits complete beginners, who get guided instruction without needing prior gym experience, as well as experienced gym-goers who want an efficient, time-limited workout. Trading from the Dixon Street entrance to Cape Quarter on Somerset Road, the studio suits anyone who wants a short, structured full-body session rather than a long, unstructured gym visit.

ULMA Packaging Systems supplies packaging machinery and packaging technology from its office on Mansell Road in Killarney Gardens, Cape Town. The business is categorised as a packaging and processing machinery supplier, reflecting its focus on equipment for businesses that need to package products at an industrial scale rather than by hand.

It operates as the Cape Town arm of ULMA Packaging, part of the wider Spanish ULMA Group, giving the local office access to the group's established packaging technology and engineering support. The Killarney Gardens office serves businesses across the Western Cape that need packaging equipment and solutions for their production lines, from smaller manufacturers to larger industrial operations. Customers dealing with ULMA typically work directly with the local team on equipment selection, installation and ongoing support rather than through general retail channels.

Virgin Active Waterstone Village is a health club on the ground floor of the Waterstone Village office block in Somerset West. Members have access to cardio and strength equipment, a heated lap pool, sauna and steam room, along with a full timetable of group exercise classes and personal training.

The club also runs a supervised kids' club where children can be looked after while a parent trains, making it practical for families rather than just individual members. As part of the national Virgin Active chain, the Waterstone Village club follows the group's full-service model, combining strength and cardio training with wellness facilities and classes under one roof. It suits adults training alone, couples, and families in the Helderberg area who want a single club that covers fitness, recreation and childcare in one visit.

items.description:
Zone Fitness Tokai is a gym inside Blue Route Mall on Tokai Road, offering dedicated cardio equipment, free weights and a group-training studio running a variety of classes. Members can combine structured classes with independent cardio and strength training in the same visit, depending on what they feel like on a given day.

The club is part of the Zone Fitness chain, launched in 2002 with a fitness-for-all approach built to make training affordable and unintimidating rather than exclusive, and the brand now runs clubs across the country. The Tokai club keeps long weekday hours, opening from 05:30 to 21:00 Monday to Thursday and 05:30 to 20:00 on Fridays, with shorter hours of 07:00 to 17:00 over the weekend. It suits early risers, after-work gym-goers and anyone in Tokai who wants a straightforward gym without having to work around short opening hours.

items.description:
Akiya Sushi is a sushi and Japanese restaurant with a branch in the Axis Building on Bridgeway in Century City. Its menu goes beyond classic sushi and sashimi, adding a dedicated hot pot menu built around sukiyaki, ramen dishes and a tea house selection alongside the main sushi offering.

Akiya operates more than one branch under the same name, and the Century City location runs its own sushi specials and events through the year rather than simply mirroring a single central menu. The restaurant trades from the Axis Building on Bridgeway in Century City, within easy reach of the area's other restaurants and retail. It suits diners who want a sit-down sushi and Japanese meal with more variety than a typical takeaway counter, including hot pot and ramen alongside the raw bar.

items.description:
Atlantic View Pharmacy is a pharmacy in the Belzac Centre on 6th Avenue in Melkbosstrand, offering prescription medication dispensing alongside general health and wellness products. It serves as a day-to-day healthcare stop for patients who need to fill a script or pick up everyday health items without travelling further afield.

The pharmacy operates as one of the pharmacies under the Merlot Group, giving it the backing of a larger pharmacy group while still functioning as a local, community-facing store. This combination suits residents of Melkbosstrand and the surrounding coastal communities who want a pharmacy that knows its local patient base rather than an anonymous big-chain branch. Visitors can expect the standard dispensary and over-the-counter healthcare range from a single storefront in the Belzac Centre.

items.description:
Bishop Lavis Secondary School is a public secondary school at 57 Helderberg Road in Bishop Lavis, serving learners through their full secondary school career. The school's own focus is on academic achievement combined with personal growth and community development, rather than academics alone, backed up by extracurricular activity alongside classroom teaching.

The school currently has 1,429 learners taught by 39 educators, a scale that places it among the larger secondary schools in the area, and it publishes its NSC matric results each year as part of its own reporting. It serves secondary-school learners from Bishop Lavis and the surrounding communities, offering a public school option close to home rather than requiring a longer daily commute. Families can expect a school that reports openly on its academic outcomes and positions itself around more than exam results alone.

items.description:
Cafe Puka is a neighbourhood coffee shop and restaurant on the corner of Brunswick and Tamboerskloof Roads in Tamboerskloof. It has built a reputation for reasonably priced, belly-filling breakfasts and lazy lunches served in an unhurried, low-key setting away from Cape Town's busier main strips.

The cafe's outside porch tables are part of its appeal, giving regulars a spot to read, work through a crossword or simply watch the neighbourhood go by over a cappuccino, alongside indoor seating for cooler days. It trades daily from 08:00 to 18:00, Monday to Sunday, making it a reliable breakfast-to-late-afternoon stop rather than a short morning-only service. It suits locals and visitors who want a relaxed neighbourhood breakfast or lunch spot with both indoor and outdoor seating in Tamboerskloof.

items.description:
Cash Crusaders Avonwood is a second-hand retail store in Avonwood Centre, on the corner of 35th Avenue and Balvenie Avenue in Elsies River. The store buys and sells a wide range of used goods, from electronics and appliances to tools, giving customers both a place to pick up discounted second-hand items and a way to turn unwanted goods into cash.

As part of the national Cash Crusaders chain, the Avonwood branch follows the group's buy-sell model rather than operating as a straightforward retail shop. It trades Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00, Saturdays from 09:00 to 17:00 and Sundays from 09:00 to 15:00. It suits Elsies River shoppers looking for affordable second-hand goods, as well as anyone nearby wanting to sell on unused electronics, tools or appliances rather than let them sit unused at home.

Cashbuild is a South African building materials retailer, and its Delft Mall branch on Delft Main Road stocks cement, timber, hardware, plumbing supplies and tools for contractors and home-improvement customers alike. The Shop V1 branch also mixes paint to order and takes quotation requests, whether a customer walks in or submits the request online.

The branch offers free local delivery, so customers buying bulkier building materials do not need their own transport to get a load home or onto a site. It trades Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 18:00, Saturdays from 07:00 to 16:00 and Sundays from 08:00 to 14:00, giving tradespeople and weekend DIYers a wide window to get materials sorted. It suits contractors restocking for ongoing jobs as well as homeowners tackling a single home-improvement project from the Delft Mall centre.

items.description:
The Chiropractic Health Centre is a chiropractic practice on the 3rd floor of The Point building on Regent Road in Sea Point. The practice treats musculoskeletal pain and injuries through chiropractic consultations and sports massage, working with an interdisciplinary team rather than a single practitioner seeing every type of case.

It takes a patient-centred approach, treating a wide range of patients from athletes and office workers to manual workers, older patients, pregnant women and children, rather than focusing on a single type of injury or age group. The Sea Point practice is one of several the group runs across Cape Town, giving it the backing of a larger team while still operating as a local, appointment-based practice. It suits anyone in Sea Point and the surrounding Atlantic Seaboard dealing with back, neck or joint pain who wants chiropractic treatment alongside massage therapy in one visit.

Clicks Golden Acre is both a retail store and a registered pharmacy inside the Golden Acre shopping centre in central Cape Town, accessible from the Castle Street entrance. The pharmacy side runs under its own listed contact line, separate from the general store line, reflecting how Clicks operates its pharmacy counters as a distinct service within each branch.

Shoppers can fill prescriptions and get pharmacist advice at the dispensary, then move through the same store for everyday health, beauty, personal-care and household products. As part of the national Clicks chain, the Golden Acre branch follows the group's standard pharmacy-plus-retail format, giving CBD shoppers and office workers a single stop for both. It suits people working or shopping in central Cape Town who want to combine a pharmacy visit with general health and beauty shopping in one trip.

Clicks Longbeach Mall is a pharmacy and retail branch of the Clicks chain trading inside Longbeach Mall in Noordhoek. The store pairs a full pharmacy dispensary with the chain's usual health, beauty, personal-care and household product range under one roof.

Longbeach Mall lists Clicks among its stores, and the branch keeps the centre's own trading hours rather than a separate schedule, so shoppers visiting the mall for groceries or other errands can combine a pharmacy stop in the same trip. It serves residents of Noordhoek and the wider southern Peninsula who would otherwise need to travel further for a full-service pharmacy. It suits anyone picking up a prescription, chronic medication or everyday health and beauty products while already at the mall for something else.

items.description:
TAH Green Point is a veterinary hospital at 86 High Level Road in Green Point, Cape Town. The practice joined the TAH group in 2016 and runs a full hospital alongside a vet shop that sells premium pet food, merchandise and treats. Its services include vaccinations, consultations, dental care, surgery and specialist medicine.

The practice's own site says it is one of the most sought-after practices in the City Bowl, and it offers online booking as well as a contact form. The group lists emergency contacts at its Bellville and Rosmead branches. It suits pet owners in the City Bowl who want a full hospital and a retail shop in one place.

TEARS Animal Rescue, also known as The Emma Animal Rescue Society, is a non-profit animal welfare organisation based in Sunnydale, Cape Town. Its mission is to rescue, treat, rehabilitate and rehome domestic animals, and to provide veterinary services to local communities. It describes its aim as a sanctuary for companion animals in need.

The organisation runs community veterinary clinics in areas including Masiphumelele and Ocean View, and works with community and animal welfare groups. Its website offers ways to adopt and foster cats and dogs, and it runs a community cat project. It suits people who want to adopt, foster or support animal welfare in the Cape Peninsula.

The Fish Hoek Galley is a seafood restaurant at Bayside on Fish Hoek Beach, Cape Town. Its tagline is seafood at its best, and the menu runs from early until late. The Galley serves grilled prawns, linefish, seafood platters and classic fish and chips.

The Bayside complex also has the Beachcomber Bistro, where guests can eat on the beach or seated indoors, and the Drifters take-away for quick orders. The group says no booking is too large to accommodate. It suits families, groups and visitors to Fish Hoek who want seafood by the sea. Guests can eat on the beach or seated, according to the group's site.

The Happy Uncles is a halaal fine-dining restaurant in Salt River's Spice Yard on Voortrekker Road, Cape Town. It opened in 2021 and describes itself as bringing South Africa a halaal fine-dining experience with a primary focus on quality. The menu is built around tasting menus of four, six and eight courses, without pork or alcohol.

The restaurant's site lists its five-course and seven-course menus, and it has offered a winter special on these. It also takes reservations online and asks guests to give 24 hours' notice to cancel. The restaurant suits diners who want a refined tasting menu and a halaal dining experience in the city.

Wembley Meat Market is a butchery in the Wembley Building on Belgravia Road in Athlone, Cape Town, part of the Wembley Group of Companies. It sells exclusively A-grade halaal meats, sourced from local abattoirs and kept on an unbroken cold chain in its own walk-in refrigerators.

The market's polonies, cold meats and atchars are made in house, and its meat is delivered fresh every day. Its website says it draws customers from around the Peninsula. It suits households who want quality halaal meat and prepared products from a single butchery. Customers can buy fresh cuts as well as cold meats and atchars from the same counter.

Ashley's Family Restaurant is a long-standing family restaurant in Goodwood, Cape Town, at 123 Voortrekker Road. Its menu covers seafood, steaks, burgers, pasta, pizzas, ribs and chicken, and the restaurant hosts a carvery on Wednesday evenings and Sunday lunchtimes.

The restaurant offers deliveries and takeaways, and it publishes its Goodwood menu online as a PDF. Its website lists awards for social media mastery and service excellence in 2025, and its Facebook page describes it as Best in the Cape for several years. It suits families who want a broad, relaxed menu in Goodwood. The family also runs a Kraaifontein branch, which has its own menu and location page.

Authentic Aesthetics S.A is a beauty and aesthetics salon at 37 Ayrshire Street in Rondebosch East, Cape Town. Its services include facials and skincare, acne facials and acne treatments, dermaplaning, facial extractions and microdermabrasion.

The salon also offers body and skin treatments such as body sculpting, massage and makeup services, and it lists these on its Fresha booking page. Laser hair removal and skin-lightening treatments are also offered by appointment. The salon suits clients in Rondebosch East and nearby suburbs who want facial and body treatments close to home. Clients can book treatments online through its Fresha listing, which also shows the salon's address and services.

Basilico Steenberg is an Italian restaurant in Steenberg Village Centre in Tokai, Cape Town. The restaurant is known for its wood-fired pizzas, and its menu is wider than that. Starters include a roast pepper and artichoke salad, chicken tortellini in a mushroom and thyme cream sauce, and springbok carpaccio with pecorino.

Mains include grilled pork fillet with garlic and ginger sauce, and lamb cutlets with roasted red pepper and feta salad. The wine list features Constantia Valley labels alongside other South African wines. The restaurant is open from Monday to Sunday for lunch or dinner, and it suits friends, celebrations, romantic dates and corporate get-togethers.

BOA Beauty Bar is a nail and beauty salon in De Ville Centre on Wellington Road in Durbanville, Cape Town. Its services include gel manicures and pedicures, standard manicures and pedicures, acrylic nails, BIAB builder gel, PolyGel nails and Medicure pedicures.

The salon has a 4.7 rating from more than 9,000 reviews on its Fresha booking page, and clients can book online with instant confirmation. The salon also offers a men's pamper package, and it suits clients in Durbanville who want nail work and beauty treatments in a single visit. Clients can book online through its Fresha listing, which also shows the De Ville Centre address and the salon's services.

Body 20 Studio is an EMS training studio inside De Ville Centre in Durbanville, Cape Town. It offers 20-minute workouts that use electro-muscular stimulation, with a coach guiding each session. The studio says its sessions use advanced EMS technology with personalised coaching, with one coach for every two members.

The studio's site describes its training as a smarter 20-minute workout, and it says the team has been at this studio for more than a decade. Members can book a demo session online. It suits people who want to see results without spending hours in a conventional gym, and who prefer a guided, small-group approach.

The practice is a sport and spine physiotherapy clinic at Panorama Healthcare Centre on Hennie Winterbach Street in Panorama, Cape Town. It treats sports injuries, orthopaedic conditions, back and neck pain, and offers rehabilitation. The practice also offers dry needling as part of its treatment.

Patients can book online and choose their physiotherapist when they make a booking. The clinic lists separate rates for private patients and for those using medical aid. It suits people who want physiotherapy for sport, spine and musculoskeletal problems close to Panorama and nearby suburbs. The practice's site puts sports injury, orthopaedic and rehabilitation work at the centre of its services.

Cafe Extrablatt is a German-style all-day cafe on Main Road in Green Point, close to the Greenpoint Stadium. It is a double-storey venue with cosy nooks, sunny seating and outside spaces, and it has a full bar on both floors. The menu covers a breakfast buffet, pizzas and hamburgers, along with seasonal specials.

There is free parking opposite the venue, and the Mycity Greenpoint centre is a short walk away. Children are welcome, and the cafe serves crayons and milkshakes. Bookings are taken for both floors on weekdays and the downstairs area at weekends, with VIP seating upstairs on weekends. It suits families, groups and visitors to Green Point.

Cattle Baron Plattekloof is a steakhouse in Plattekloof Shopping Centre, Cape Town, and sits in the heart of the northern suburbs. It has been a prime spot for steak lovers for more than 20 years, and it is part of the Cattle Baron restaurant brand.

A buffet is offered on Wednesdays and Fridays, and the site has a gallery and franchise information. It suits families, groups and steak lovers in the northern suburbs who want a relaxed meal out. Its menu is built around steak, and the branch is part of the Cattle Baron restaurant chain. The branch's site includes a gallery and contact details for bookings.

CitiVet Gardens is a veterinary clinic at 7 Aandbloem Street in Vredehoek, Cape Town. Its services include consultations for diagnosis and annual check-ups, surgical procedures and laboratory work, and primary healthcare for new pets. The clinic says it can admit all surgical and medical cases to its hospital.

The clinic also stocks prescription veterinary food ranges and most other pet products, and it will order items it does not have in stock. Its site describes a helpful and friendly team available for pet-related questions. It suits pet owners in Vredehoek and the City Bowl who want a clinic that can handle both routine care and hospital admissions.

The firm is a medium-sized law practice with offices in Cape Town and Table View, at Unit 2, 42 Blaauwberg Road. It has offered legal services since 1999, and its site describes a commitment to personal attention for clients.

The practice covers conveyancing, commercial law, general litigation, family law, wills and trusts, and notarial services. Its website also offers cost calculators and resources to help clients understand the work. It suits homeowners, families and businesses in Table View and the northern suburbs who need an attorney for property or personal legal matters. Clients who need several kinds of legal work can deal with one practice, which the firm describes as a full suite of legal services.
